headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: By integrating public trend signals, ClearInstall can leverage AI to provide more accurate and real-time risk assessments during package installations, enhancing user trust and security. This will involve improving the lockfile analysis and binding.gyp command expansion checks.
